summary: Replace the table-heavy PR template with Summary, What changed, How verified, Links, and Visual evidence sections; document gh --attach for screenshots and bootstrap/import seeding when the template file is absent (#1049).
migration_impact: Run `gh plate import-payload --strategy safe` (or conservative when the path is missing) to add or refresh `.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md` in downstream repos. Conservative import leaves a customized template unchanged.
agent_notes: Repo and payload copies must stay identical. Do not commit screenshot binaries; use `gh pr create|edit --attach` per template guidance.
